summary: Arranges children in a circle or arc. A real LayoutGroup, so it needs no calls.
overview: Use it instead of a Horizontal or Vertical Layout Group to place children around a circle or along an arc. Unlike the masonry grid this IS a proper layout group, so children snap into place automatically with nothing to call.
useCases: Ability icons around a character portrait.

params.tuning: 0 is up. Worth setting deliberately — a menu that starts at an odd angle looks unintentional.
360 spreads evenly all the way round; smaller values make a fan. At exactly 360 the first and last items sit on top of each other unless you account for it.
Right for a clock face or dial, wrong for icons that must stay upright to be readable.

gotchas.title: A full 360 arc overlaps its ends
gotchas.body: The first and last child land at the same angle. Use slightly less than 360, or accept the overlap.
